verdict.rationale: Cekura has a dedicated Python metric type that lets users "write custom evaluation logic in Python... with complete control" (cekura-docs-8), which is the core of code-based custom scorers. LLM-judge metrics, rubric-based custom success criteria and rule-based conditional evaluators supplement it. Evidence of Python metrics running on ingested call logs (cekura-docs-25) supports that these scorers apply to real evaluation data. missing for 10: details of the Python metric API (inputs, return types, libraries/sandbox limits), evidence of scorer versioning and reuse via SDK/CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of custom code scorers.
